elements.requirement: Subject to the following provisions of the Taxes Management Act 1970 and to any other provisions of the Taxes Acts allowing a longer period in any particular class of case, an assessment to income tax or capital gains tax may be made at any time not more than 4 years after the end of the year of assessment to which it relates.
elements.quote: an assessment to income tax or capital gains tax may be made at any time not more than 4 years after the end of the year of assessment to which it relates

elements.requirement: An objection to the making of any assessment on the ground that the time limit for making it has expired shall only be made on an appeal against the assessment.
elements.quote: shall only be made on an appeal against the assessment

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 34 of the Taxes Management Act 1970, the term assessment does not include a self-assessment.

thresholds.what: The maximum time limit after the end of the year of assessment to which it relates within which an assessment to income tax or capital gains tax may be made
thresholds.quote: not more than 4 years after the end of the year of assessment to which it relates
